svg.aria-label: A small example. Left: two quadrilateral elements, e1 with the nodes 1, 2, 3, 4 and e2 with the nodes 5, 6, 7, 8, separated by a gap; node 2 faces the middle of the facet 5-8 of e2, and a contact constraint c couples node 2 with this facet once the gap closes. Below: the ID array, two DOFs per node, node 1: 0, 1 up to node 8: 14, 15, and the location of c, 2, 3, 8, 9, 14, 15. Middle: the sparsity pattern of the system matrix, one cell per pair of nodes, before the contact: two separate blocks, nodes 1 to 4 and nodes 5 to 8. Right: the pattern with the contact, case (a): the pairs 2-5, 2-8, 5-2 and 8-2 are added. The numbering is the same in both; the locations and the pattern change: Change.LOCATIONS.
svg.title: A small example. Left: two quadrilateral elements, e1 with the nodes 1, 2, 3, 4 and e2 with the nodes 5, 6, 7, 8, separated by a gap; node 2 faces the middle of the facet 5-8 of e2, and a contact constraint c couples node 2 with this facet once the gap closes. Below: the ID array, two DOFs per node, node 1: 0, 1 up to node 8: 14, 15, and the location of c, 2, 3, 8, 9, 14, 15. Middle: the sparsity pattern of the system matrix, one cell per pair of nodes, before the contact: two separate blocks, nodes 1 to 4 and nodes 5 to 8. Right: the pattern with the contact, case (a): the pairs 2-5, 2-8, 5-2 and 8-2 are added. The numbering is the same in both; the locations and the pattern change: Change.LOCATIONS.
